predicates.contains: Only users set up by the central Admin team can sign in.
Sessions end after 30 minutes of inactivity.

inline:the-two-notes-under-the-sign-in-f.statement: The two notes under the sign-in form show a 14px icon that matches the 12px text, aligned with the first line, and keep their size when the text wraps on a phone.
inline:the-two-notes-under-the-sign-in-f.subject: signin

nextjs-routing.statement: On Next.js, a signed-out user who opens a deep link (with its query string) is sent to sign-in and, after signing in, lands back on that exact link; the sidebar's Admin entry opens the first admin section the user may see (/admin/institutions for Admin).
nextjs-routing.subject: signin
